title: Two Words Lighter Than a Breath, Heavier Than Mountains

captions.tiktok: Two phrases so light on the tongue, so heavy on the scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful. Sahih al-Bukhari 6682.
captions.shorts: Light on the tongue, heavy in the balance, beloved to the Most Merciful. Sahih al-Bukhari 6682, Sahih Muslim 2694.
captions.reels: Two phrases so light on the tongue, so heavy on the scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful. Sahih al-Bukhari 6682.

segments.text: There are two short phrases so light you could say them without thinking... and yet on the Day of Judgment, they land on the scale heavier than mountains.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, called them a treasure.
segments.title: LIGHT, YET HEAVY
segments.titleSub: two words beloved to ar-Rahman, the Most Merciful

segments.text: He said: two words are light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful. Then he said them.
Subhaan Allahi wa bihamdih. Glory to Allah, and all praise to Him.
Subhaan Allah al-Azeem. Glory to Allah, the Most Great.
Feel the strangeness of it. On that Day, deeds are weighed, and people watch their scale, terrified it is too light. These words, that cost you a breath, come down on it like a mountain.
And there is a second reward hidden in the same sentence. They are beloved to the Most Merciful. You are not just filling a scale. You are saying something your Lord loves to hear.
So take them with you. Two lines, under your breath, all day. Subhaan Allahi wa bihamdih... Subhaan Allah al-Azeem. The lightest thing you will do today... may be the heaviest thing you own tomorrow.
